verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Intuit publishes an MCP *server* exposing QuickBooks' own API to external AI agents (quickbooks-gh-3/4/5), which is the opposite role — it lets other agents call QuickBooks, not QuickBooks calling out to external MCP servers/tools. There is no evidence that QuickBooks' own AI assistant (Intuit Intelligence) can be configured to plug in and consume external MCP servers as tools.
